name: DUMBBELL KICKBACKS
introduce: Stand upright, hold a dumbbell in each hand by your sides. Lean forward, and bend your knees slightly. Bend your elbows, and bring the dumbbells towards your chest.\n\nExtend your arms behind you, and squeeze your triceps. Bring the dumbbells back to your chest. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please squeeze your triceps when extending your arms behind you.
Exhale when extending your arms and inhale when bringing it back.
This exercise targets your triceps and helps sculpt your arms.
